top_story.headline: Mendonça asks the full court to suspend Moraes over the Banco Master probe

items.text: Mendonça asked the full court to suspend colleague Moraes while the plenary decides whether to open a corruption inquiry tied to the Banco Master case.
The Federal Police report flags up to five possible crimes by Mendonça as Master rapporteur, including steering the plea deal toward chosen targets.
The probe now also touches suspected ties to the Primeiro Comando Capital, Brazil's largest organized-crime group.
A Sept 7 rally is set as a show of support ('desagravo') for Mendonça, with the Bolsonaro brothers expected.

editors_note: The STF crisis escalates: mutual suspensions on the table, a PF report listing five crimes, and a political rally on Sept 7.
